title: Recruitment application lifecycle mail
summary: Recruitment applicants now get an email when they apply and when there is a decision on their application.
changes: Email applicants to confirm their Recruitment application was received.
Email applicants when their application is shortlisted, rejected, accepted, or closed.
Link each email to the applicant's own application page and keep staff notes out of every email.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.42 line: new Recruitment emails on the existing email foundation, with no change to the Recruitment workflow.
validation: Recruitment manage, workflow, access matrix, and public board tests.
composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
known_limitations: Decision emails start respecting the Email contact preference in 0.42.8.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
